newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan overnight rates fluctuate, end at 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan overnight rates fluctuate, end at 12 pct.

text.p: Pakistan overnight rates fluctuated between 12 and 18 percent before closing at 12 percent, dealers said.
At the outset, trades were made at 16 percent but borrowing pressure forced the rate up to 18 percent, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
In the last hour of trading, rates suddenly dropped to 12 percent when some big lenders came up with large amounts, the dealer said. Rates were likely to stay soft on Tuesday.
